reviews.text: Great place! They took great care of my puppy and when I got him back he was super clean! He smells nice and I'll definitely bring him back! They have good prices too so that's a plus! 10/10 :)

If I could give 10⭐️'s I would! I was so scared to leave my Prince for several hours. He's my everything and my main concern is that Prince has a collapsed trachea and is blind as well! I cried all the way home. My baby hasn't been to a groomer for over 3 years due to his health but he really needed to get groomed.. The staff really took consideration and assured me that they were going to take good care of him.. I'm very grateful for the service they provided my little aka Daddy boy💙🐶🐾🐶
Friendly staff!! My puppies first grooming went amazing!
Decided to give this place a try, and definitely did not disappoint.  Will from now on become my dogs groomer.
Thank you Heaven for my Dog, Osito’s, haircut! My dog looks and smells great! The staff is also super friendly! 5/5 stars

We’ve been taking our two furbabies to Puppy Power Resort for some time now. Bree has been our groomer and she ALWAYS does a fantastic job. We are so happy to have found Puppy Power. They treat everybody’s furbabies with the very best care.

Drop off our dog for a week boarding.  5 days out, called and checked to find out that our dog got put in a small kennel because the bigger kennel were not available and  got a quite big scratched on her nose and bled.
As soon as we get home, we went to pick her up right away. We didn't want to leave her there any longer.
My point is since they see the size of the dog and if the kennel is unavailable why take the dog in? Just very disappointed.
I've been taking my dogs here for grooming and boarding for a few years now.  Great customer service and reasonable prices.  My fur babies love Bri.  She always makes them look amazing.

took my pup for a bath + groom 7/30 and the service was INCREDIBLE!! They checked us in/out quick, took amazing care of my dog and provided the best customer service I’ve ever experienced! The prices are THE BEST I’ve ever paid for everything they did! Will definitely be returning soon :,)

Since moving to two this has been the best place for our pup and our family. Every time we have gone to them our pup has been well groomed and well taken care of. Additionally when my family had an emergency hospital stay they were willing to help us with overnighting our dog despite the short notice. The owner and staff have been nothing but amazing!

I found this place of Google with great reviews and all, so decided to give it a try…. Allí was Loki’s groomer today and she did a fantastic job on Loki, never at his other grooming place had they trimmed all the fur under his upper lip and Allí did trimmed it and left my beautiful boy so handsome ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Thank you so much!!

Thanks to Bree & Denise for taking care of my cupcake ❤️ it was very hard finding someone to trust groom my cupcake since she’s paralyzed from her back legs. But I am soooo happy & satisfied. I am glad I found someone who I can trust. She looks so cute! ❤️
My fur son loves coming here. The staff always makes him feel loved! Thank you all for having the love for that you have for everyone's fur kids.

We’ve been taking our dog here for a few years. They are by far the best dog grooming facility in San Antonio. We’ve tried others only due to scheduling, but none come close to the customer service, rates and outcome that Puppy Power does. 1000% recommend.
